decisions.reason: As a distributed finishing system with its own product page and an established role in the portfolio, the cutting and creasing finisher carries enough sunk marketing effort and visible commitment that management will persist with it.

The UV spot varnishing system was publicly staged as a German premiere at a customer event and featured on the home page, so strong public commitment and the need to justify that investment make dropping it very unlikely.
The sheet preparation module is less prominent but complements the finishing line the firm sells, and any weak results can still be attributed to the early market phase, so it is kept.
The B2 multifinisher was announced on the home page as the firm's new B2 solution, making it central to the direction the firm has proclaimed and therefore something management will defend.
The hybrid saddle stitcher has a dedicated page and fits the core finishing portfolio, so the investment already made and its strategic fit favour keeping it.
The folding add-on unit already has a documented customer installation that the firm publicised, giving a visible success reference that reinforces commitment to the product.
